title: Food Diary
description: Log meals with calories from a food database, daily totals, saved in your browser.
howto: Pick the date and the meal.
Search and choose a food, enter the grams, and add it.
Entries are saved automatically in your browser.
See daily totals for calories, protein, carbs, and fat; delete entries as needed.

faqs.a: Only in your browser's localStorage, keyed by date. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
Yes. Change the date picker to any day and log entries there.
They come from typical per-100g values, so treat daily totals as close estimates.
